description: This file defines the interface for the IFA (Identifier for Advertisers) extension in the Cobalt project, including function pointers for retrieving advertising IDs, tracking preferences, and user authorization status, as well as registration and unregistration of callbacks.

methods.name: GetAdvertisingId
methods.description: Retrieves the advertising ID or IFA, typically a 128-bit UUID.

methods.name: GetLimitAdTracking
methods.description: Checks if advertising tracking is limited.

methods.name: GetTrackingAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Gets the user's authorization status for using IFA.

methods.name: RegisterTrackingAuthorizationCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for tracking authorization status changes.
